# Source Origins

The corpus was retrieved on 2026-08-23 from arXiv and the official SPARC data site. Local SHA-256 hashes, rather than mutable upstream version labels, define the frozen artifacts used by this module; upstream links are confined to this provenance note so ordinary reading can remain local.

## Retrieval policy

- An unversioned arXiv PDF or source URL was used to obtain the latest version available on the retrieval date.
- Jacobson’s 1505.04753v1 was additionally frozen because the nonconformal claim changed materially before publication.
- The matching arXiv source payload was saved for every PDF.
- [[vendor/entropic-gravity/sources/arxiv-metadata.xml|arxiv-metadata.xml]] is the local Atom response for all 33 unique identifiers and preserves current version, author, abstract, category, DOI, and journal-reference fields.
- Published journal PDFs were not duplicated when the author manuscript and its source were available from arXiv.
